title: RNA Clean-Up by Phenol:Chloroform
author: Daniel J. Richter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8y3hxyn

steps.title: Initial Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform the first phase separation to remove proteins and contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 μL (1/10 of final volume) of 3 M sodium acetate, pH 5.2, to reach a final concentration of 0.3 M.
Add 880 μL (2x volume) of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol pH 8.0.
Shake vigorously inside a fume hood for 15 seconds.
Centrifuge at maximum speed in a microcentrifuge at 4°C for 2 minutes.
Check the solution for insoluble precipitate, which indicates the presence of potassium salts > 20 mM.
Transfer 420 μL of the top aqueous phase to a new tube.

steps.title: Chloroform-Isoamyl Alcohol Wash
steps.instruction: Perform a second extraction to further purify the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Add 840 μL of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol pH 8.0.
Shake vigorously inside a fume hood for 15 seconds.
Centrifuge at maximum speed for 2 minutes at 4°C.
Transfer 400 μL of the top aqueous phase to a new tube.

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the RNA from the aqueous phase using ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 μL of GlycoBlue (working stock 15 micrograms/microliter, final amount ~ 25 micrograms).
Add 1000 μL (2.5 volumes) of 100% ethanol.
Shake vigorously inside a fume hood for 15 seconds.
Centrifuge at maximum speed for 10 minutes at 4°C.

steps.title: Ethanol Wash and Drying
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet and remove residual ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Slowly pipette out ethanol using a P1000 then a P10, avoiding liquid on the sides of the tube.
Wash with -20°C 70% ethanol and centrifuge at maximum speed for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Slowly pipette out ethanol using a P1000 then a P10, avoiding liquid on the sides of the tube.
Dry the pellet.

steps.title: Resuspension and Quantification
steps.instruction: Resuspend the purified RNA and determine its concentration.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 27.5 μL of water.
Measure concentration using a NanoDrop.
Dilute a 1 μL aliquot of RNA to 1 ng/μL in a separate tube for Bioanalyzer analysis.
